questions.history: After confirmed EOF call read on an eight-byte buffer at offset 2 and length 0.
questions.prediction: The parent returns −1 after remembering EOF. The merge returns 0 with all eight cells unchanged.
questions.basis: The InputStream contract cited in #434 specifies zero for a zero-length request. The request covers no cells.
questions.refutation: A nonzero return, exception or changed buffer cell on the merge.

questions.history: Before consuming the file, issue the same zero-length read and then read one byte.
questions.prediction: Both should return 0 then 1, with all sentinel cells preserved.
questions.basis: Reading zero bytes cannot consume the first byte.
questions.refutation: A changed array, a nonzero count or a different first byte.

questions.history: On a fresh empty file confirm EOF with read(), then alternate read(buffer,buffer.length,0), read() and another identical empty slice.
questions.prediction: The merge should return 0, −1, 0 in order, with unchanged storage.
questions.basis: The endpoint is a valid empty slice. No call can create data in an empty file.
questions.refutation: A legal endpoint is rejected, an empty slice reports EOF, or a positive request returns data.
